name: Barnyard Millet Pongal
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ¼ cup split moong dal, rinsed
½ tsp each cumin seeds and black peppercorns, crushed
Salt and a pinch of hing
steps: Dry-roast the moong dal for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the millet and water with salt, and pressure-cook for 3 whistles, or simmer covered for 20 minutes until very soft.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin and pepper, and add ginger, curry leaves and hing.
Pour the tempering over the pongal and mash lightly.
Serve hot with sambar or coconut chutney.
note: Traditionally finished with cashews and ghee; here the nuts and ghee are left out.
